config.label: Free API key from open
config.description: Free API key from open.fda.gov — increases daily limit from 1K to 120K requests.

config.label: Serve exact-key lookups for drug/label, drug/ndc, drug/enforcement, and drug/drugsfda from a local bulk mirror instead of the API
config.description: Serve exact-key lookups for drug/label, drug/ndc, drug/enforcement, and drug/drugsfda from a local bulk mirror instead of the API. Off by default; the initial harvest runs out-of-band via the mirror:init script.

config.label: Directory holding one SQLite file per mirrored dataset
config.description: Directory holding one SQLite file per mirrored dataset.

config.label: Cron expression for the in-process mirror refresh
config.description: Cron expression for the in-process mirror refresh. HTTP transport only; stdio operators run mirror:refresh from the host. Requires the optional node-cron peer dependency.

config.label: Fall back to the live API when the mirror is cold, missing the record, or failing
config.description: Fall back to the live API when the mirror is cold, missing the record, or failing. Disable to fail loudly instead.

config.label: Wall-clock budget for one scheduled refresh before it is aborted
config.description: Wall-clock budget for one scheduled refresh before it is aborted. Raise it for drug/label, the only multi-partition dataset.

config.label: Host serving the openFDA bulk download manifest
config.description: Host serving the openFDA bulk download manifest. Override only to harvest from a private mirror of the dumps.

config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
